content: <thought>To generate a one‑step retrosynthesis for the target molecule C=C(C1=CC=C(OC)C=C1)C2=CC=C(OC)C=C2, I will look for a retrosynthetic template that corresponds to the Peterson olefination. In the forward direction this reaction forms a C=C double bond while breaking a carbonyl (ketone) and a trimethylsilyl group. Therefore, I will search the template catalog for a reaction that forms a C=C bond and breaks a ketone and a trimethylsilyl group. Once a suitable template is found, I will construct the required JSON route showing the target molecule as the parent, the reaction node with the found template_id, and the two precursor molecules (the corresponding diaryl ketone and a trimethylsilyl reagent).
